rationale: The stock gapped up strongly on blowout earnings (131% YoY revenue growth) but has since pulled back significantly from the session high of $237.12 to $225.07, sitting below the 9-EMA ($226.97) and showing choppy, low-volume 1-minute candles with no clear directional momentum. The wide bid-ask spread (52.4 bps) and erratic price action (ranging from $209 to $237 intraday) make precise entry and stop placement unreliable, and with 145 minutes to close the risk/reward for either direction lacks a clean mechanical setup.
